extraction: 2024 Table 1 parameters manually transcribed with SI conversion; equations 1–3 and Table 3 checked against full-text page rendering. 2023 method full text retained separately.
role: Evidence-bound ex vivo nonlinear constitutive materializations; source-defined layers remain distinct from generic body anatomy
limitations: Three donors aged 75–89, frozen postmortem tissue; no whole-population or living-subject parameter covariance.
CS effective fit includes urethra; fascia has no individual specimen measurements; glans and skin parameters unavailable.
Circumferential tunica architecture is a model assumption requiring explicit reference-space direction.
No measured viscosity, damage, active tone or perfusion coefficients.
D2=0 interpreted as omission of the higher-order volumetric term; native Abaqus parity remains unverified.
